purpose: Stable hierarchical task stack. Every new science action must justify itself against all parent levels before execution.

L0_NORTH_STAR.goal: Qualify full MeanVC2 Vocos cold4/warm6 under strict QNN ownership/no CPU fallback: frozen host numerical gate first, host structural qualification second, target-phone HTP final truth third, then production integration in lly8666/SimAdmin-Android.
L0_NORTH_STAR.contingency: ACTIVE wider multi-block/prefix or full-Vocos student route after exact and Add3 single-boundary correction failed protected validation.

L1_PHASE.goal: Learned host numerical recovery with teacher/full-Vocos CPU, QNN-CPU, disjoint heldout/stress, then strict HTP truth.
L1_PHASE.strategy: Increase optimization unit/capacity only when supported by disjoint data; do not fit one trajectory.

L2_MECHANISM.name: WIDER_STUDENT_FOUNDATION
L2_MECHANISM.causal_reason: Add3 residual is final-sensitive but not predictable from Add3 state by the frozen low-rank grid. Correcting deterministic rounding noise locally is therefore not a stable route. A wider student can alter the early-prefix representation/conditioning rather than predict the local error directly.
L2_MECHANISM.mechanism_budget: Before architecture search, establish a broad realistic nonfinal corpus with provenance and disjoint train/validation/heldout/stress. If current assets only contain the single 47-block trajectory, expand corpus first.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_success: Corpus breadth is sufficient to train and reject overfit wider-student designs; freeze first architecture/split before training.
L2_MECHANISM.exit_failure: Insufficient corpus -> build capture/export pipeline; do not train on synthetic/off-manifold or final A/B/C data.

L3_EXPERIMENT.question: Do existing authorities contain enough distinct realistic nonfinal MeanVC2/Vocos inputs to train and validate an early-prefix/adjacent-block student without trajectory overfit?
L3_EXPERIMENT.method: Inventory local/repository/recovery assets and provenance; classify by sequence/fixture/state. Exclude final device A/B/C, seed 20260814 and synthetic A as promotion data. Quantify independent sequences and frames before choosing architecture.
L3_EXPERIMENT.closure: Current authorities are insufficient. Build a new deterministic multi-sequence nonfinal corpus export path before training; sequence-level split can only be frozen after authorized realistic sources exist.

L4_ACTION.action: Restore the controlled main-repository sandbox and implement/validate the frozen multi-sequence nonfinal MeanVC2/Vocos corpus export contract. Do not train or score wider-student architectures yet.
L4_ACTION.parent_alignment: This is the required L2 exit-failure path after the audit found zero promotion-eligible independent realistic nonfinal sequences. It creates the data foundation needed to prevent trajectory memorization before model capacity is increased.

mandatory_zoom_out_triggers.insufficient_corpus: Build broader nonfinal corpus before training; do not compensate with more model complexity.
